scripts.build:ui: bun run --cwd ../web build && rm -rf dist && cp -R ../web/dist dist
scripts.dev: bun run build:ui && bunx electrobun dev
scripts.dev:hmr: bun run build:ui && concurrently -n vite,electrobun "bun run --cwd ../web dev" "bunx electrobun dev"
scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bunx electrobun build --env=stable
